system.description:
• Effect: Your first shot each round curves around cover and shields. Half Cover doesn't give you Disadvantage on it, and the target's shield adds 2 less to its AC.
  • 10th level: it can also curve around Full Cover: you can target a creature behind it, with Disadvantage. It ignores the target's shield entirely, magic included.
  • 11th level: it applies to every shot you make, not just the first each round

rules.value: Bent Path: {1:your first shot each round ignores the Disadvantage from Half Cover and reduces a shield's AC bonus by 2, 10:your first shot each round ignores the Disadvantage from Half Cover, can curve around Full Cover (with Disadvantage) and ignores the shield entirely, 11:every shot ignores the Disadvantage from Half Cover, can curve around Full Cover (with Disadvantage) and ignores the shield entirely}.
